comments.value: Please consider adding this because large groups have multiple reoccurring events and is very frustrating to have to keep entering them. And if it is added please make it so individual events can be edited to update art or details. Thank you very much.
MThis feature would greatly help us manage our  weekly events.  It I It's a challenge to have to manually do it each week when it's the same thing
This feature would save time, reduces manual entry, and be very useful for planning ongoing events. Having this feature would make the calendar far more efficient and user-friendly.
Yes! This feature 100% needed for all the aforementioned reasons.
This would be a huge help for communities with weekly events. Definitely supporting this request! Thank you!
We need a way to set reoccurring events in the calendar. Come on and make this happen! This should be a simple request.
Allowing recurring events would be excellent for the VRC community and position VRC competitively against similar platforms, making this a mutually beneficial recommendation.

Recurring events are a must-have feature for our community.

We run at least six weekly events, and having to manually recreate each event every single time is exhausting and inefficient.

I strongly request support for recurring events. These events need to be reliable and flexible:

 - It should be possible to cancel a single occurrence without deleting the entire series.

 - There should be an option to pause/freeze the whole series if needed.

 - Most importantly, the event itself must not be deleted, and subscribers to the event must not be lost.

 

This is critical because it allows events to build and maintain their own audience. If subscribers are preserved, we don't need to post announcements to the entire group every time just to notify people - only those who are actually interested will receive notifications.

Additionally, for security and moderation reasons, only the event creator or a main group admin should be able to delete an event. In large groups with many event organizers, compromising a single account should not allow someone to delete other organizers events and wipe out their subscriber base.
Can we get status update on this topic? Repeating events was bullet point for February 24 VRChat update patch notes

details: Please add the ability to create recurring events in the event calendar. My group has 6 weekly events, and recreating them every time is frustrating
title: [1674] Recurring Events
